“不是说好的，让你等我回去吗？你来做什么？”太子皇甫陌轩问蓝汐冷，语气已不似刚才那般恼怒，带着些许的温柔，是蓝若晴许久都不见的温柔……
“唉哟！妾身这不是等的着急了吗？”蓝汐冷娇嗔着回答着。“雨儿也闹着要父王，哦不，是父皇。我就带他来了。”
将怀中的婴儿交与皇甫陌轩，一切是那么的自然，而皇甫陌轩的动作是那样的娴熟。
蓝汐冷转身看向蓝若晴，轻声的说：“姐姐，这是我与太子、哦，不，是皇上的皇子皇甫秋雨，已经六个月了大了。雨儿出生在那个雷雨交加，你噩梦惊醒找不到太子的夜晚！为了纪念你的失去，所以取名雨儿。皇上说雨儿是嫡长子，故会立为太子，而我是雨儿的亲生母亲，自然是皇后。”
轻叹一声，蓝汐冷继续道：“其实我也不想这样做，只是我实在是太喜欢陌轩，从他那天勇于跳入水中救你时开始，我就爱上他了。只是他的眼里心里只有你一个人。从小我就嫉妒你，只因你是嫡女，我是庶出，所以你我生就不同。你是将军府的嫡小姐，所有的光环都是你的。从那一天起，我便暗暗发誓，所有属于你的，我必抢来占为己有。现在，你的男人，你的地位，都是我的！甚至你引以为傲的家，现在也是梦寒在掌管。哦，忘了告诉你，其实，爹爹不是被你气死的，而是我和梦寒在爹爹的药中偷偷的加了几味，所以……哼哼！那个老不死的，只喜欢你的娘亲，还一直都觉得你才是他的骄傲，一直都不正明我的身份和地位。即使在娘亲扶正做当家主母，梦寒成为将军府接班人之后，他也始终不肯正视我。所以我恨他！”
望着蓝汐冷那张狰狞的脸，蓝若晴突然觉得一阵阵的反胃，不知是因为怀孕引起的反应，还是因为蓝汐冷那张因仇恨而扭曲的面孔导致她作呕。
“现在，我即将成为晟睿国的皇后，这世上再也没有人可以藐视我！我不需要再对任何人陪着笑脸，也不用再费尽心机的争取。我已是一人之下，万人之上！这世上，再也没有我惧怕之人！我也不必再看任何人的脸色。”
蓝汐冷起身走到桌边，轻轻的触碰那碗堕胎药，仿佛对待自己的亲儿般温柔。
继而轻声的说道：“姐姐，你还是把这药喝了吧！这样子对你，对皇上都好不是？这要是传出去，姐姐您背着皇上偷人，还有了身孕，若是生下了野种，以后让皇上怎样一统天下？别忘了，明日可就是登基大典。这做了皇帝的人，不和你计较你给他戴了绿帽子，已经很大度了，你还想要怎样呢？只是一碗堕胎药而已，也没什么大不了的。”
端起那碗药，蓝汐冷走到蓝若晴身边，俯身在蓝若晴耳边说：“其实，当年你娘亲与辰一诺，是被我与我娘下了药用了熏香才晕倒的。你看到的，根本就不是事实，就连他们的衣服，都是我脱的！……”

> Chapter 3 The Truth (Page 1)
"Didn't we agree to let you wait for me to go back? What are you doing here?" Crown Prince Huangfu Moxuan asked Lan Xi Leng, his tone no longer as angry as before, with a little tenderness, which Lan Ruoqing had not seen for a long time...
"Oh! Aren't I waiting impatiently?" Lan tide replied coldly and angrily. "Yu'er also made a fuss about asking for the father. Oh no, it's the father. So I brought him here."
Handing the baby in his arms to Huangfu Moxuan was so natural, and Huangfu Moxuan's movements were so skillful.
Lan Xileng turned to look at Lan Ruoqing and said softly: "Sister, this is me and the prince, oh, no, it's the emperor's prince Huangfu Qiuyu, who is already six months old. Yu'er was born on that night when there was a thunderstorm and you woke up from nightmares and couldn't find the prince! In order to commemorate your loss, I named you Yu'er. The emperor said that Yu'er is the eldest son, so he will be crowned prince, and I am Yu'er's biological mother, so naturally I am the queen."
With a sigh, Lan Xi Leng continued: "Actually, I don't want to do this, but I really like Mo Xuan so much. Ever since he had the courage to jump into the water to save you that day, I have fallen in love with him. But he only has you in his eyes and heart. I have been jealous of you since I was a child. , just because you are the legitimate daughter and I am a concubine, we are born differently. You are the legitimate daughter of the General's Mansion, and all the glory belongs to you. From that day on, I secretly vowed that everything that belongs to you, I will take it for myself. The status is all mine! Even the home you are proud of is now in charge. Oh, I forgot to tell you, in fact, dad was not mad at you, but Meng Han and I secretly added some flavor to dad's medicine, so... hum! He only likes your mother, and he always thinks that you are his pride, and he never understands my identity and status. Even after my mother became the mistress of the house and Meng Han became the successor of the general house, he still refused to look at me. "
Looking at Lan tide Leng's ferocious face, Lan Ruoqing suddenly felt nauseated. She didn't know whether it was due to the reaction caused by pregnancy, or because Lan Xi Leng's face was twisted with hatred and made her gag.
"Now, I am about to become the Queen of Shengrui Kingdom. No one in this world can look down on me anymore! I no longer need to smile at anyone, and I no longer need to work hard to win. I am already inferior to one person and above ten thousand people! There is no one I fear in this world! I don't need to look at anyone's face anymore."
Lan tide Leng stood up and walked to the table, gently touching the bowl of abortion pill as if he were treating his own child.
Then he said softly: "Sister, you'd better drink this medicine! Isn't this good for you and the emperor? If this spreads out, sister, you stole someone behind the emperor's back and you are pregnant. If you give birth to a bastard, what will the emperor do in the future? Rule the world? Don’t forget, tomorrow is the enthronement ceremony. It’s very generous of the person who becomes the emperor not to care about you. What else do you want? It’s just a bowl of abortion pills, it’s no big deal.”
Picking up the bowl of medicine, Lan tide Leng walked to Lan Ruoqing, leaned over and said in Lan Ruoqing's ear: "Actually, your mother and Chen Yinuo were drugged and incenseed by me and my mother before they fainted. What you saw is not the truth at all. Even their clothes were taken off by me!..."
